items.exampleEn: In formal writing, the subjunctive appears in phrases like 'I suggest that he be on time.'
items.exampleZh: 在正式文體中，假設語氣會出現在 I suggest that he be on time 這類句子裡。

items.exampleEn: Each examinee received two pencils and a number card at the door.
items.exampleZh: 每位考生在門口拿到兩支鉛筆和一張號碼牌。

items.exampleEn: The dictionary marks each transitive verb with a special symbol.
items.exampleZh: 這本字典用一個特別的符號標示每個及物動詞。

items.exampleEn: In the phrase 'my red car', the word my is a determiner.
items.exampleZh: 在 my red car 這個片語裡，my 是限定詞。

items.exampleEn: Some verbs, like 'run', can be both transitive and intransitive.
items.exampleZh: 有些動詞，例如 run，既可以是及物，也可以是不及物。

items.exampleEn: During the long snowstorm, the town opened a cyberschool so classes could continue.
items.exampleZh: 那場漫長的暴風雪期間，小鎮開辦了網路學校，讓課程能繼續。

items.exampleEn: On the form, please write down your first language and any others you speak.
items.exampleZh: 請在表格上寫下你的母語，以及你會說的其他語言。

items.sentenceEn: Sleep is an intransitive verb, so it does not take an object.
items.sentenceZh: sleep 是不及物動詞，所以後面不接受詞。

items.audioEn: All examinees must leave their phones at the front desk before entering the hall.
items.audioZh: 所有考生進入考場前，都必須把手機留在前台。
items.questionZh: 考生進考場前要把什麼留在前台？

items.sentenceEn: My cousin studies at a cyberschool because her family travels a lot.
items.sentenceZh: 我表妹在網路學校上課，因為她家常常旅行。

items.sentenceEn: Choosing the right determiner, such as a or the, can be tricky.
items.sentenceZh: 選對限定詞（例如 a 或 the）可能不太容易。

items.stemEn: Make is a ____ verb, so it needs an object, as in 'make a cake'.
items.stemZh: make 是及物動詞，所以需要受詞，例如 make a cake。

items.stemEn: 'If I were you, I would rest' is an example of the ____.
items.stemZh: 「如果我是你，我會休息」是假設語氣的例子。

items.passageEn: My friend Lena's first language is German, but she now teaches English grammar at a cyberschool. Her students live all over the world and join classes online. This week, she taught the difference between transitive and intransitive verbs, using simple examples like 'eat an apple' and 'sleep well'. She also explained determiners and the subjunctive, which many learners find confusing. Next month, her students will take a big exam, so she is preparing each examinee with practice tests. Lena says teaching grammar is like coaching a sports team: you need patience, practice and a little fighting spirit.
items.passageZh: 我朋友莉娜的母語是德語，但她現在在一所網路學校教英文文法。她的學生住在世界各地，透過網路上課。這週，她用 eat an apple 和 sleep well 這類簡單例子，教及物動詞和不及物動詞的差別。她也講解了限定詞和假設語氣，很多學習者覺得這兩者很難。下個月，她的學生要參加一場大考，所以她正用模擬考幫每位考生準備。莉娜說教文法就像訓練運動隊伍：需要耐心、練習，還有一點鬥志。

items.promptZh: 很多孩子在學校說的語言不是他們的母語。
referenceEn: Many children speak a language at school that is not their first language.
For many children, the language they use at school is not their first language.
rubricZh: first language 指母語（例如 their first language）
時態合理即可（例如 speak、is）

items.promptZh: 我奶奶的母語是客家話，但她也會說英文。
referenceEn: My grandmother's first language is Hakka, but she can also speak English.
Hakka is my grandma's first language, but she speaks English too.
rubricZh: first language 指母語（例如 her first language 等）
「也會說」可寫，例如 can also speak、speaks… too 等
